description: Setiap organ bekerja sendiri tanpa hubungan dengan organ lain.
evidencePattern: Student selects answers indicating organs function independently
correctiveConcept: Organs work together as systems to keep the body functioning.
supportStrategy: Use body system diagrams and organ interaction examples.

description: Salah menghubungkan organ dengan fungsi tubuhnya.
evidencePattern: Student mismatches organs with their functions
correctiveConcept: Each organ has a specific function that supports the body.
supportStrategy: Provide organ-function matching practice with visual cues.

evidencePattern: Student orders food path as mouth → stomach → small intestine
correctiveConcept: Food travels from mouth to esophagus before reaching the stomach.
supportStrategy: Use animated food journey showing esophagus as a connecting tube.

description: Stomach is the main place where nutrients are absorbed.
evidencePattern: Student identifies stomach as primary absorption site
correctiveConcept: The small intestine is the main place where nutrients are absorbed.
supportStrategy: Compare organ functions with emphasis on small intestine's role.

description: Large intestine is the main place where nutrients are absorbed.
evidencePattern: Student identifies large intestine as primary absorption site
correctiveConcept: The small intestine absorbs most nutrients; large intestine absorbs water.
supportStrategy: Clarify the different roles of small and large intestines.

evidencePattern: Student selects answers showing organs don't interact
correctiveConcept: Digestive organs work as a connected system.
supportStrategy: Show how food moves through connected organs in sequence.

description: Makanan sehat hanya berarti makanan yang rasanya tidak enak.
evidencePattern: Student associates healthy food only with unpleasant taste
correctiveConcept: Healthy food can be delicious and varied.
supportStrategy: Show examples of tasty, nutritious foods.

description: Semakin banyak makanan yang dimakan, semakin sehat.
evidencePattern: Student equates eating more with being healthier
correctiveConcept: Balanced portions and variety matter more than quantity.

description: Aktivitas fisik hanya diperlukan ketika seseorang ingin berolahraga.
evidencePattern: Student thinks physical activity is only for formal exercise
correctiveConcept: Daily movement and activity support overall health.
supportStrategy: Show everyday activities that count as physical activity.
